stories.text: 👀 All eyes on Moore (BUF @ MIN): if Moore tops 12.26 pts, Mr. Action Jackson (50%) beats Ruffing the Passer. ESPN projects 12.68 pts.
👀 All eyes on Allen (BUF @ MIN): if Allen tops 23.26 pts, Claremont In Yo Stace! (40%) beats Kyle Tucker. ESPN projects 20.21 pts.
⚔️ SHOWDOWN: Ramosverse leads TDsMaGee (27%) by 35.86 pts — it's Hockenson (BUF @ MIN) vs Cook III and Jefferson (BUF @ MIN) the rest of the way.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 43% / 21%, Mr. Action Jackson 87% / 65%.
📈 COMEBACK: Ramosverse was down to 17% against TDsMaGee — now 73% to win.
😅 Ruffing the Passer is sweating out a close one with Mr. Action Jackson (50% to win). Starting AJ Barner over Adonai Mitchell would have helped.
😅 Kyle Tucker is sweating out a close one with Claremont In Yo Stace! (60% to win). Starting Denzel Boston over Omarion Hampton would have helped.
🧟 ZOMBIE STARTER: Tyler Loop was on injured reserve. Gibb it to Me Baby started him anyway. Inspiring commitment.
🪑 Gibb it to Me Baby has left 32.88 pts on the bench this week. Starting Brock Purdy (25.28 pts) over Jared Goff (5.30 pts) alone was worth 19.98 pts.
📝 REPORT CARD WATCH: Gibb it to Me Baby is trending toward a F this week. Benching Brock Purdy (25.3) and Chris Olave (16.8) has cost 32.88 pts so far.
🔥 Bucky Irving is on fire — 28.50 pts, 12.59 pts over projection for Kyle Tucker.
👀 League gossip: Gibb it to Me Baby may be wishing they trusted Brock Purdy — 25.28 pts are sitting on the bench.
💓 The Mahomies outlasted Gibb it to Me Baby after the favorite flipped 3 times.
